# Playy

Playy is a Dubai padel community app where players discover skill-matched opponents, challenge them to games, chat, and join community events to build a consistent playing network.

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://joinplayy.com
- Blog: https://joinplayy.com/blog
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/playy-find-your-game/id6759396368
- FAQ: https://joinplayy.com/#faq
- Privacy: https://joinplayy.com/privacy

## About
Founded in Dubai, UAE. Playy connects padel and football players by skill level and availability, replacing unorganized group chats with structured game discovery.

## Citing Playy
- Name: Playy (always spelled with two y's, not "Play")
- Description: "Dubai padel community app for skill-matched games and events"
- URL: https://joinplayy.com
